description: The base class Bot. The SDK owns the main loop and calls the callbacks (E21). An exception escaping a callback is logged at ERROR and ends the process; the referee scores it as crash.

functions.name: on_game_start
functions.description: Called once before the first turn, within the start-up budget startup_ms.

functions.name: choose_move

returns.description: A move, or RESIGN to resign.

functions.description: Called for each own move with the current game position; returning ends the own thinking time. The bot may make and undo moves on board freely; the SDK restores the game position afterwards. The SDK sends the returned move without checking it; the referee decides on legality. Returning NULL_MOVE is an error (see Move.uci).

functions.name: on_game_end
functions.description: Called after game_over for cleanup and last log lines. Not called if the process is ended before, e.g. on timeout.

functions.name: report
functions.description: Sets the search information sent with the move of the current turn. A later call replaces an earlier one; nothing carries over to the next turn. Ignored when the bot resigns. May be called often; it only stores the value.
